evaluator_agreement.result: evaluate.py is the arena verifier verbatim. On the three published solutions it returns 0.3808585748578583 (arena 0.3808585748578584), 0.3808586772158396 (arena 0.38085867721583955) and 0.38085905681456067 (arena 0.3808590568145606): one unit in the last place each, largest relative difference 2.9e-16. The exact rational values from verify.py round to the same three doubles evaluate.py returns.
evaluator_agreement.note: Solution 2407 sums to exactly 256.0 in float64, so the arena does not rescale it, but its exact sum is 256 - 6.4e-16; rescaled exactly, its largest height would be 1 + 2.5e-18. verify.py allows 1e-12 of slack on the post-rescaling bound for this reason.

other_published_values_note: The problem record cites problem 6.5 of arXiv:2511.02864 (Georgiev, Gomez-Serrano, Tao, Wagner). The paper was not read during this session, so no value from it is listed here.
